eligibility.reason: A maintained robot-description package supplies a wrong transform value to a model consumer. The declaration crosses a boundary, so an edit inside the description package does not make the defect internal. PAIR is supported at the model/consumer level; the particular robot_state_publisher identity is inferred rather than named by the reporter.

failed_conditions.reason: The SIA20 hunk changes the fixed link_t-tool0 orientation. frame_mismatch is defensible for the wrong physical frame definition, not a frame-ID spelling conflict; robot_description is the coarse-grained model interface element.
